label: 2,3-butanediol fermentation
definition: A fermentation in which microorganisms convert sugars to acetoin and 2,3-butanediol neutral end products through the butanediol pathway.
observations: Product-specific acetoin and 2,3-butanediol fermentation sibling of ethanol, propionic acid, butyric acid, and acetone-butanol-ethanol fermentation; absent from METPO and TraitMech after a 2,3-butanediol fermentation duplicate review covering ignored and hidden files.
